extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 1.0.7: Marking a part-watched film or episode as watched from the Trakt menu now shows the tick. Its resume points (SpongeTV's own, and Trakt's) are removed as well, as they are when you watch to the end; before, the part-watched icon stayed and it still offered to resume. 1.0.6: Next up, Shows in progress and other long lists open faster. SpongeTV now keeps a small summary of each show you've watched, so working out what's next no longer reads every show in full. Settings are read through one shared handle while a list is built, not a new one for each read. A title TMDB says it doesn't have is remembered for a day, not asked for on every visit. Films and shows that rarely change are no longer rewritten each time they're read, and are now refreshed when their time is up. 1.0.5: A second measuring build with no change to how SpongeTV works. With Kodi's debug logging on, the log now also shows each step of building a list (for example Next up and Shows in progress) and how many cache reads, database lookups and network requests it made. This is to find what makes those lists slow. Earlier changes: changelog.txt
